headline: India wins over Afghanistan by 7 wickets in rain-hit ODI
summary: Shubman Gill's unbeaten 84 and strong bowling led India to victory in a rain-reduced 25-overs-a-side match in Dharamsala.
details: India secured a seven-wicket victory over Afghanistan in a rain-reduced 25-overs-a-side ODI on Saturday. The win gives India a 1-0 lead in the three-match series, marking the first ever 50-over series between the two nations.

headline_marked: Brazil fan [[loses toe after generator falls]] on him in Patuakhali
headline: Brazil fan loses toe after generator falls on him in Patuakhali
summary: A celebratory procession was halted after a generator accidentally fell on a supporter's foot, causing a severe injury.
details: A Brazil football supporter in Patuakhali suffered a severe injury when a generator fell on his foot during a celebratory procession.
The impact was so strong that it resulted in the loss of a toe from the victim's foot.
Following the accident, the planned procession was immediately suspended to address the emergency.
The incident highlights the risks associated with heavy equipment during large public gatherings and celebrations.
caption:
A football celebration turned tragic in Patuakhali when a generator fell on a fan's foot, severing a toe.

A Brazil football supporter in Patuakhali suffered a severe injury when a generator fell on his foot during a celebratory procession.

The impact was so strong that it resulted in the loss of a toe from the victim's foot.

Following the accident, the planned procession was immediately suspended to address the emergency.

The incident highlights the risks associated with heavy equipment during large public gatherings and celebrations.
